key_reasoning.reason: The spec scoped the drag bar out, but removing the typed-edit cap and peer cascade in UnifiedProjectBudgetModal let category sums go above or below 100%. That exposed UnifiedBudgetDragBar hit-testing and rebalance maths, so code review needed a fix-up and then a residual fix. This is a real gap in the scope, though a minor one.

There was no exact precedent for the new toVisual normalization (drag maths in flex-weighted visual space), the Platform-minimum floor while rescaling far-over-100% states, or the legacy Platform-0 guard. The tests are large parameterized edge-case tables (it.each over categories and full-form vs distribution-only modes, plus boundary values such as 0, negative, empty, sub-minimum and over-total). They follow the existing modal test template, so no auto-bump applies. The change has no security, auth or persistence-contract impact, and the save payload shape is unchanged.

The diffstat shows 4 files (+418/-34), which maps to M on the 4-6 band. Two are production components (UnifiedProjectBudgetModal, UnifiedBudgetDragBar) and two are test suites. All four are in one directory, src/pages/settings/administration/components/. Most of the inserted lines are tests.
